messages.subject: Error building rlang
parts:
When I try to publish my app I get this:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 332266...DONE
Deploying bundle: 1343608 for application: 332266 ...
Waiting for task: 522686054
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building package: rlang
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 522686055 failed: Error building image: Error building rlang (0.2.0). R version 3.5.0 currently unavailable
Execution halted

Looks like it has to do with the version of R I am running? Is there a work around?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error building rlang
parts:
It takes shinyapps.io a day or two after the Ubuntu packages become available on CRAN, when a new version of R comes out.
R 3.5.0 is not yet available, so for now you will need to downgrade your version of R.
